description_expanded: OverviewBella Vista A Quiet Lakeside Escape on 30A WELCOME TO BELLA VISTA Some places invite you to slow down the moment you arrive. Bella Vista sits quietly along the edge of Camp Creek Lake, where the water is calm, the pace is slower, and the beauty of 30A feels a little more personal. Mornings begin with coffee on the deck as the sun rises across the lake. You might see someone paddling quietly across the water or casting a fishing line from the dock while the rest of the day unfolds gently. Later, you might bike to the beach, paddle across the lake to a hidden stretch of sand, or wander down to The Big Chill for dinner, music, and an evening under the lights. And when the day winds down, the lake becomes still again it's the perfect setting for stories around the fire pit, a glass of wine on the balcony, or simply enjoying the quiet. Bella Vista was created to be a peaceful retreat... a place to reconnect with the people you're with and the beauty of the coast around you. THE SETTING Bella Vista sits directly on the tranquil waters of Camp Creek Lake, one of the rare coastal dune lakes along 30A. These lakes exist in only a few places in the world and create a unique environment where fresh water and saltwater meet offering calm paddling waters, incredible wildlife, and peaceful views just minutes from the Gulf. From the private dock, you can launch a kayak or paddleboard and make a short 300-yard paddle to a quiet beach access. If you prefer to walk or bike, Gulf Lakes Public Beach Access is about ½ mile away, making beach days simple and easy. This rare combination of lakefront and beach access is one of the things that makes Bella Vista so special. OUTDOOR LIVING Life here naturally happens outside. The backyard opens to the lake, creating a beautiful space to relax, play, and enjoy the water throughout your stay. You'll find: A private dock perfect for fishing or launching paddles 2 kayaks, a paddle board, and a pedal boat for exploring the lake 4 bikes for cruising along 30A A large deck overlooking the water for morning coffee or sunset drinks A fire pit for relaxed evenings under the stars Beach chairs, umbrellas, and toys ready for your beach days Outdoor shower for rinsing off after a day at the beach Whether you're beginning the day with a paddle or ending it beside the fire, the lake becomes part of the rhythm of your stay. THE HOME Bella Vista is designed to feel comfortable, welcoming, and relaxed. The home includes 2 bedrooms and 1 bathroom, comfortably sleeping up to 4 guests, making it perfect for couples, small families, or a friends' getaway. Inside you'll find bright, inviting living spaces where everyone can gather after a day at the beach or on the water. Large windows and the balcony look out over the lake, letting the peaceful setting become part of the experience of the home. Sleeping Arrangements Primary Bedroom: Queen bed Second Bedroom: Two twin beds Perfect for a couple with children, two couples, or friends traveling together. EXPLORE NEARBY 30A Bella Vista is located in one of the most convenient and peaceful areas of 30A; close to the energy of the beach towns, yet tucked away in a quiet lakeside setting. Within just a few minutes you can explore some of the best dining, shopping, and entertainment along the coast. The Big Chill (Formerly The Hub) 3 minutes | 1 mile A lively outdoor gathering place with restaurants, live music, outdoor movies, and family-friendly fun. It's an easy bike ride and a favorite spot for casual dinners and evening entertainment. WHY GUESTS LOVE BELLA VISTA Guests often say the best part of Bella Vista is the balance it offers. You have the beauty and excitement of the beach… but also the quiet calm of the lake. You can explore the towns along 30A during the day… and return to a peaceful dockside sunset in the evening. It’s a place to paddle, fish, bike, relax, and reconnect. A PLACE TO SLOW DOWN Whether you're planning a romantic getaway, a small family vacation, or a quiet retreat by the water, Bella Vista offers a space to slow down and enjoy the simple moments that make a trip memorable. Coffee on the deck. Sunsets over the lake. Barefoot evenings around the fire. Welcome to Bella Vista. Bella Vista: Lower floor of a two-level cottage, it can be rented alone or with Coastal Chateau. The dock is shared if rented separately.Show less
